paragraphs: Yose, his son, was one of the Zugot who received the tradition from Antigonus of Sokho; Avot, chapter 1, mishnah 4.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Yose his-son naturally refers to the heading Yochanan. The Zugot classification and reception from Antigonus of Sokho remain Hyman’s assertion; the-tradition supplies the understood object of received. No external identity or historical verification follows.
אבות פ״א מ״ד explicitly gives Avot chapter 1 mishnah 4, without independent named-edition verification. No separate personal title is supplied for these names.
